.ie \n(.g .ds Aq \(aq
.el .ds Aq '
.TH fnord-date 1  "fnord-date " 
.SH NAME
fnord\-date \- Display today\*(Aqs (or a given) Discordian date
.SH SYNOPSIS
\fBfnord\-date\fR [\fB\-d\fR|\fB\-\-date\fR] [\fB\-s\fR|\fB\-\-short\fR] [\fB\-a\fR|\fB\-\-apostle\fR] [\fB\-H\fR|\fB\-\-holydays\fR] [\fB\-f\fR|\fB\-\-format\fR] [\fB\-\-help\-format\fR] [\fB\-h\fR|\fB\-\-help\fR] 
.SH DESCRIPTION
Display today\*(Aqs (or a given) Discordian date
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
\fB\-d\fR, \fB\-\-date\fR
Date to display
.TP
\fB\-s\fR, \fB\-\-short\fR
Short output
.TP
\fB\-a\fR, \fB\-\-apostle\fR
Include apostle
.TP
\fB\-H\fR, \fB\-\-holydays\fR
Include holyday info
.TP
\fB\-f\fR, \fB\-\-format\fR
Custom format string
.TP
\fB\-\-help\-format\fR
Show format token reference
.TP
\fB\-h\fR, \fB\-\-help\fR
Print help
